code='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    c = n // 2
    candidates = []
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row):
        if color == 7:
            continue
        coords = [(r, col) for r in range(n) for col in range(n) if grid[r][col] == color]
        if any(r >= c for r, _ in coords):
            candidates.append((len(coords), color, coords))
    _, color, coords = max(candidates)
    out = [[7 for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
    dr = 1 if sum(r for r, _ in coords) / len(coords) > c else -1
    dc = 1 if sum(col for _, col in coords) / len(coords) > c else -1
    for k in range(c + 1):
        out[c + dr*k][c + dc*k] = color
    return out
'''
